post.description:
Executes live Typhoon Weather Disruption End-to-End Scenario:
News Event -> Supplier Risk -> Compliance Check -> IBM watsonx RAG -> IBM Granite LLM Reasoning -> Decision Agent Strategy & Recommendations.

Executes real IBM watsonx.ai Granite model text generation
for supply chain risk analysis.

Flow:
Input -> FastAPI -> IBM watsonx.ai Granite
-> Structured Risk Analysis JSON.

Existing AegisFlow Supply-Chain AI Chatbot.

This endpoint is intentionally preserved.

Sends a user message to the deployed
IBM watsonx Orchestrate AegisFlow agent.

This is a separate endpoint so the existing
/chat endpoint is not affected.
